data.question: What Fall 2026 ECP requisitions are currently visible on official WEF Workday surfaces?
data.method: Bounded exact-title and location search over public WEF Workday detail pages, preserving only IDs exposed by official pages.
data.framework: Exact requisition IDs are recorded only when exposed by WEF Workday; similar-job titles without detail URLs remain unresolved leads.
findings: Exact official requisitions recovered: R4072, R4203, R4211, R4214, R4218 and R4228.
R4228 is a new official Beijing Greater China CRTG role relative to the July inventory.

R4203 currently exposes a Similar Jobs entry titled 'ECP Fall 2026 – North America and Latin America Regional Teams' in New York, but the indexed page does not expose that job's requisition ID or detail URL.
No requisition ID is inferred for the Regional Teams role.
conclusions: The complete-requisition-inventory target remains open because at least one current official Workday title lacks a recovered exact requisition ID.
recommendations: Continue Workday enumeration until every visible Fall 2026 ECP title resolves to an exact requisition ID or is documented as withdrawn/unavailable.
counterarguments: Search-engine indexing can lag Workday and therefore cannot prove the six recovered IDs are the complete set.
limitations: No authoritative WEF endpoint enumerating the entire Fall 2026 ECP cohort was recovered in this pass.
unresolved: requisition ID and detail URL for North America and Latin America Regional Teams
current official Workday identity/status for North America and Latin America Government Teams

workflow.next_action: Recover exact IDs for all currently visible Workday ECP titles.
